components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #A9AEA9); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #17191B); font: 600 0.875rem/1.5 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #007A43); border-color: var(--accent, #007A43); color: var(--accent-ink, #FFFFFF); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #006637); border-color: var(--accent-strong, #006637); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #007A43); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.css: .ds-fascia { position: relative; display: flex; height: 64px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--canvas, #ECEDE9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #CDD0CB); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seg { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 20px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg-protected { background: var(--protected, #52565A); color: var(--protected-ink, #F1F2EE); } .ds-seg-spendable { background: var(--accent, #007A43); color: var(--accent-ink, #FFFFFF); } .ds-seg-cross { background: var(--signal, #C8261E); color: var(--signal-ink, #FFFFFF); padding: 0 16px; } .ds-seg-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-seg-amount { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-mark { flex: none; width: 8px; background: var(--ink, #17191B); border-inline: 2px solid var(--canvas, #ECEDE9); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); }

narrative.overview:
Margine is drawn like a Milan Metropolitana platform: a dark stone rail on the left, enamel panels for content, and one continuous band of colour at eye level across the top that tells the user, in two stretches, what is protected and what is spendable. The band is to scale. Its stone stretch is Risparmio protetto, its line-green stretch is Denaro spendibile, and each stretch carries exactly one message: a small uppercase label over a large signage amount. Everything else on screen is quieter than the band.

The system is a working desk tool, not a showcase. Density is moderate, structure comes from hairline rules and ruled rows rather than cards, and there is one grotesque (Archivo) set with tabular figures everywhere. Colour is committed and sparse: stone and green carry meaning, red appears only for an exception or a deficit, and everything else is enamel, ink and tinted grey. A system-dark variant swaps every token through `prefers-color-scheme` while keeping the same roles.

Rejected by the build: three equal stat cards and a donut as the dashboard answer; cards as structural containers; a second type family.
keyCharacteristics: One full-width signage band (64px) holds the money state, segments sized to amounts.
Stone rail, enamel ground, ink text; one accent green; signal red reserved for exception and deficit.
Archivo only, tabular numerals on every amount, tracking tightens as size grows.
Hairline rules and ruled rows instead of cards; square-ish 4px corners.
Motion is short (100 to 200ms), on transform, opacity and clip-path, with one ease-out curve.

rules.name: The Two Stretches Rule
rules.body: Stone means protected and green means spendable, everywhere. Neither colour is used for anything that could be read as the other's money.

rules.name: The Red Means Exception Rule
rules.body: Signal red appears only when protected money is touched or the goal is in deficit. It is never decoration, never a generic destructive colour, never a second accent.

rules.name: The Enamel Not Black Rule
rules.body: Text is Platform Ink, surfaces are tinted enamel; no pure black or pure white grounds.

rules.name: The Tight At Size Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing tightens as size grows: -0.035em at display, -0.02em at headline, -0.01em at title, normal at body; only the small uppercase signage label opens up (+0.04em).

rules.name: The Tabular Everything Rule
rules.body: Every amount uses tabular numerals; the body sets `tnum` globally.

rules.name: The Only Overlays Float Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element sits above the page (sheet, toast). Nothing at rest in the page flow carries a shadow.

dos: Do keep the fascia as the first thing on every view and give each stretch exactly one label and one amount.
Do use stone only for protected money and Linea Green only for spendable money, primary actions, income and focus.
Do set every amount in Archivo with tabular numerals, tightening tracking as size grows (-0.035em at 5.5rem).
Do build structure from hairline rules (1px rule, rule-strong for control borders) and ruled rows.
Do keep motion at 100 to 200ms on transform, opacity or clip-path with `cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`, and drop it under reduced motion.
Do give every control hover, focus-visible, active and disabled states.
Do open forms in the right-hand sheet below the fascia so the band can preview the change live.
donts: Don't answer "how much can I spend" with stat cards or a donut; the band and one hero figure carry it.
Don't use Signal Red for anything other than exceptions and deficits.
Don't add a second type family or use pure black.
Don't put shadows on in-flow elements; only the sheet and toast float.
Don't wrap content sections in cards or rounded panels.
Don't use uppercase outside the fascia labels and table column headers.
